requirements.title: Host representations and distinguish state
requirements.statement: The substrate shall host addressable representations of supplied structures and state, preserving modality/order/composition and qualitative or unquantified content without requiring a universal numeric or stock-flow encoding.
requirements.derivation: Engineering requirement inferred from owner mission and source review; not prescribed or validated by the book.
requirements.acceptance: A mixed numeric/qualitative fixture retains distinct source content, represented state and explicit unknowns through creation and retrieval.

requirements.title: Preserve identity, dependencies and revision lineage
requirements.statement: The substrate shall preserve internal identity, versioned dependencies and corrections without rewriting acquired evidence or equating internal representation identity with physical identity.
requirements.derivation: Engineering requirement inferred from owner mission and source review; not prescribed or validated by the book.
requirements.acceptance: A false association can be retracted or split with prior as-of state and affected dependencies still inspectable.

requirements.title: Distinguish interface and response properties
requirements.statement: The substrate shall distinguish interaction boundary/participants, permitted exchange direction, hypothesized response polarity, loop behavior and uncertain causal status, including multi-party and mediated relations.
requirements.derivation: Engineering requirement inferred from owner mission and source review; not prescribed or validated by the book.
requirements.acceptance: Directed, symmetric, unknown, multi-step and context-dependent examples remain distinguishable without promoting a directed exchange to causal proof.

requirements.title: Host scoped interaction and transition rules
requirements.statement: The substrate shall host declared or proposed interaction/update mechanisms with applicability, exchange or transformation semantics, constraints and unknowns; copying information shall not implicitly impose material-conservation rules.
requirements.derivation: Engineering requirement inferred from owner mission and source review; not prescribed or validated by the book.
requirements.acceptance: A pinned mechanism distinguishes state, rate, signal and appropriate constraints, with unknown mechanics and unsupported causal claims retained explicitly.

requirements.title: Preserve timing and history dependencies
requirements.statement: The substrate shall retain event/receipt/model-time distinctions and history required by supported delayed/asynchronous mechanisms, including perception, response and delivery delays and declared numerical timing where applicable.
requirements.derivation: Engineering requirement inferred from owner mission and source review; not prescribed or validated by the book.
requirements.acceptance: Same-current-observation/different-history fixtures, delayed updates and replay retain their distinctions and use no evidence unavailable at the recorded prediction time.

requirements.title: Compose and inspect at declared scales
requirements.statement: The substrate shall support reusable nested and overlapping views with cross-level dependencies, retaining access to evidence and declaring losses and validity limits of compression/abstraction.
requirements.derivation: Engineering requirement inferred from owner mission and source review; not prescribed or validated by the book.
requirements.acceptance: A coarse view exposes its supporting detail and any task-consequential loss; structural resemblance alone does not qualify transfer.

requirements.title: Preserve uncertainty and rival mechanisms
requirements.statement: The substrate shall preserve missing coverage, hidden-state uncertainty, conflicting and observationally indistinguishable explanations, including nonnumeric uncertainty, without treating unobserved as absent or imposing one scalar confidence.
requirements.derivation: Engineering requirement inferred from owner mission and source review; not prescribed or validated by the book.
requirements.acceptance: Under insufficient evidence, alternatives remain distinct and unresolved; unknown values or coverage cannot silently become zero, false or independent confirmation.

requirements.title: Trace evidence and imported assistance
requirements.statement: The substrate shall trace received claims, transformations, producer/model versions, imported knowledge, shared evidence and subsequent outcomes so learned experience is distinguishable from externally supplied proposals and repeated derivations.
requirements.derivation: Engineering requirement inferred from owner mission and source review; not prescribed or validated by the book.
requirements.acceptance: An assisted proposal retains lineage and shared-evidence dependence; prospective controls can isolate the declared retained/native contribution.

requirements.title: Revise context and scope
requirements.statement: The substrate shall support revisable context, regime and boundary hypotheses, preserving unknown external drivers and distinguishing the actual acquisition/action boundary from modeled world scopes.
requirements.derivation: Engineering requirement inferred from owner mission and source review; not prescribed or validated by the book.
requirements.acceptance: A previously supported relation can be narrowed, widened or invalidated under changed context without erasing earlier evidence or asserting a unique hidden cause.

requirements.title: Expose inquiry selection and stopping
requirements.statement: The substrate shall expose evidence, assumptions, selection/exposure history and candidate alternatives needed for bounded inquiry and discriminating tests; scheduling policy and its objectives shall be declared at the relevant component boundary.
requirements.derivation: Engineering requirement inferred from owner mission and source review; not prescribed or validated by the book.
requirements.acceptance: Inspection can identify selection bias and a credible challenge; inquiry can defer, stop or revisit on declared grounds without forcing equal credibility or constant model calls.

requirements.title: Separate trials, committed changes and authority
requirements.statement: The substrate shall distinguish candidate/simulation state, committed internal state, observation evidence and measured external outcomes; versioned changes shall have explicit type, authority, concurrency and failure semantics.
requirements.derivation: Engineering requirement inferred from owner mission and source review; not prescribed or validated by the book.
requirements.acceptance: Stale or unauthorized trial updates cannot overwrite evidence or commit effects; state/parameter/structure/policy/goal changes remain attributable and distinct.

requirements.title: Enable accountable reorganization
requirements.statement: The substrate shall permit supported creation, deletion/retirement, split, merge and rewiring of organization and explicit proposed mechanisms, retaining dependencies, history and declared irreversibility/loss.
requirements.derivation: Engineering requirement inferred from owner mission and source review; not prescribed or validated by the book.
requirements.acceptance: A revised organization can be inspected against its predecessor, affected derivations are handled, and the origin of generative/selection rules remains explicit.

requirements.title: Keep goals and outcome criteria explicit
requirements.statement: The substrate shall preserve inferred function, supplied task, inquiry objective, operational constraints and evaluation criteria as distinct versioned concepts; proposed changes shall not silently weaken acceptance or promote activity proxies to success.
requirements.derivation: Engineering requirement inferred from owner mission and source review; not prescribed or validated by the book.
requirements.acceptance: A proposal that lowers a threshold, increases question count or changes a goal cannot be reported as improved prediction/task performance under unchanged criteria.

requirements.title: Bound shared resources and account for complete costs
requirements.statement: The substrate shall expose and enforce its declared storage/access/update budgets and backpressure with a defined owner, including costs and failures of inquiry/model dependencies under the selected operating profile.
requirements.derivation: Engineering requirement inferred from owner mission and source review; not prescribed or validated by the book.
requirements.acceptance: A pinned workload accounts for offered/admitted/rejected work, failed calls and all relevant costs; saturation has bounded explicit behavior.

requirements.title: Preserve recoverable organization under declared retention
requirements.statement: The substrate shall provide declared durability/recovery and loss semantics, with inspectable retention/compression decisions that consider rare but relevant structures and recovery needs rather than frequency alone.
requirements.derivation: Engineering requirement inferred from owner mission and source review; not prescribed or validated by the book.
requirements.acceptance: Fault and context-change fixtures expose what survives, what is lost and why; no universal retention, perfect reversibility or HA guarantee is inferred.

requirements.title: Support reproducible prospective assessment
requirements.statement: The substrate shall expose configurations, assumptions, initial states, available evidence and candidate outcomes needed to test conditional predictions and revisions prospectively, separating model response, future-driver assumptions, numerical semantics and actual observations.
requirements.derivation: Engineering requirement inferred from owner mission and source review; not prescribed or validated by the book.
requirements.acceptance: Pinned candidate tests and appropriate unchanged/alternative/assistance controls retain full outcomes; simulation agreement or historical fit alone cannot establish causal identification, transfer or intelligence.

scope_note: Six functions, sixteen draft requirements, three logical parts, six proposed specifications and twenty-two prospective substrate cases. Native development rules, concrete contracts and operating profiles remain open. No product qualification is claimed.
